items.condition: The submission changes the public molecule's connectivity, charge, multiplicity, or stated stereochemistry without justification.
The submission reports energies or populations without preserving conformer identity, ensemble scope, units, or validation context.
The submission treats an optimized saddle point or an unvalidated geometry as a conformer minimum, or reports a pathway without endpoint-specific TS evidence or an explicit bounded failure.
The submission claims a unique experimental population or mechanism from calculated populations alone while omitting the harmonic, temperature, barrier-cutoff, or spectral-resolution limitations.
